desc:
🥚 Welcome to Dig & Steal an Egg!

The eggs aren't lying around. You DIG them out of the ground.

How to Play:
⛏️ Dig eggs out of the ground
🏃 Run home before the guardian catches you
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets
⚡ Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🚪 Steal eggs from other players
✨ Discover rarer eggs, pets, sizes, and mutations!
